description: This Kotlin file defines the HomeViewModel class for an Android weather app. The ViewModel manages the state related to the selected location and weather data, handles data loading asynchronously using coroutines, and provides functions to refresh weather data and update the location.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for the Home screen managing location and weather data, including methods to refresh weather data and set a new location.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Loads weather data for the current location asynchronously, updating the weather, loading, and error states accordingly.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Updates the current location and triggers a refresh of the weather data for the new location.
